settings.title: Hotel Settings
settings.subtitle: Configure your hotel's operational settings
settings.resetConfirm: Reset this section to its factory defaults? The change is audited and each key can be edited again afterwards.
settings.hotelNameHint: The official name of your hotel
settings.businessNumberHint: SSM number printed in the guest booking terms
settings.adminOnlyHotel: Only administrators can modify hotel information
settings.checkInTimeHint: Standard time when guests can check in
settings.checkOutTimeHint: Standard time when guests must check out
settings.nightShiftHint: Time when daily data is posted for reporting (e.g., 11:00 PM)
settings.nightAuditAutoHint: When on, the system posts the night audit at the time above (and catches up any missed days). When off, run it manually from the Night Audit page.
settings.nightShiftNote: Night shift time determines when daily booking and room data is finalized for reports.
settings.defaultCurrencyHint: All prices and charges will be displayed in this currency
settings.timezoneHint: Select your hotel's timezone for accurate time tracking
settings.currencyNote1: • Changing the currency will update all price displays throughout the system (bookings, invoices, reports)
settings.currencyNote2: • Malaysia uses Asia/Kuala_Lumpur timezone (GMT+8) and Malaysian Ringgit (MYR)
settings.adminOnlyOps: Only administrators can modify operational settings
settings.serviceTaxHint: Tax percentage applied to all bookings
settings.tourismTaxHint: Per night charge for tourist guests
settings.depositHint: Default deposit amount collected at check-in
settings.unpaidHoldOn: Unpaid online bookings are voided and their rooms released after this long. Front-desk bookings are never released automatically.
settings.unpaidHoldOff: Off. Set a number of hours to release unpaid online bookings automatically. Front-desk bookings are never affected.
settings.chargesNote: These amounts will be used as defaults in the quick booking form. Tourism tax is charged per night for guests marked as tourists.
settings.guestCancelToggle: Allow guests to cancel eligible future bookings in the portal
settings.guestCancelHint: Non-cancellable voucher terms and bookings that have reached check-in still block cancellation.
settings.supportToggle: Allow guests to start support conversations in the portal
settings.supportHint: Existing conversations remain visible to staff when new guest requests are paused.
settings.reopenWindowHint: Days after resolution during which a guest can reopen a conversation
settings.totpIssuerHint: Name shown in TOTP authenticator apps. Leave empty to use the hotel name.
settings.passkeyDisplayNameHint: Name shown during passkey registration. Leave empty to use the hotel name.
settings.themeModeHint: Choose how the interface looks on this device. This preference is saved locally and applies immediately.
settings.fontPresetCustomHint: Custom report font sizes are active

very_small.label: Very Small
very_small.description: Dense reports with maximum rows per page

medium.label: Medium
medium.description: Balanced default for screen and print

settings.fontFamilyHint: Font used by generated report previews and print output
settings.fontSizeHeadingHint: Large report titles and metric values
settings.bookingChannelsHint: Configure channel name + abbreviation pairs (e.g., Booking.com / B.C). Abbreviations appear next to guest names in the Room Sold Detail by Date report.
settings.paymentMethodsHint: Configure available payment methods for walk-in guests
settings.systemConfigNote: These options will appear in the booking channels dropdown (online check-in) and payment methods dropdown (walk-in guests).
